metadata.text:
↷: Play an additional
loot card this turn.
------------------------------
If you would loot, instead
loot that much +1.
------------------------------
As your turn starts,
discard your hand.
------------------------------
-Eternal-

When you delcare an attack on
a monster, you may give it +1 HP
and +1 AT till end of turn. If you do,
you may choose another player. They
may team up for the attack. If that
monster dies this turn, each player
that made an attack roll against it
this turn puts a HP counter on an item
they control without a HP counter.
------------------------------
-Eternal-
